title: Reproducibility package for measured detection accuracy versus proxy scores for FP16 block allocation in INT8 object detectors: a controlled study
description:
Reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript Measured detection accuracy versus proxy scores for FP16 block allocation in INT8 object detectors: a controlled study, prepared for Information Sciences.

The release contains the experiment, allocation, evaluation and bootstrap code; allocation plans and score files; the calibration list and tuning-split manifests; AP, per-group AP, sensitivity, bootstrap and Jetson latency records; and the protocol freeze record and decision rules of the post-freeze experiments. COCO, ExDark, Ultralytics checkpoints, ONNX graphs, TensorRT engines and raw predictions are not redistributed; their sources and regeneration steps are documented in README.md.

All scientific claims and metadata remain the responsibility of the five human authors. AI tools are not creators or contributors.
